attchmntText: Yatra Online Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Yatra Online Limited filed an investor presentation regarding un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was INR 2,136 Mn, a 39% year-over-year decline. Gross margins stood at INR 1,255 Mn. The company reported an EBITDA of INR 132 Mn and a net loss of INR 7 Mn. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was INR 4,015 Mn, a 28% year-over-year decline. Gross margins were INR 2,482 Mn. The company reported an EBITDA of INR 263 Mn and a net loss of INR 4 Mn. Cash and cash equivalents were INR 2,180 Mn as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Yatra Online Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Please find the enclosed herewith Press Release".
voiceSummary: Yatra Online Limited filed an intimation regarding its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-27, the company reported revenue of INR 2,136 million, a year-on-year decline of 39.1 percent. Adjusted EBITDA stood at INR 150 million, down 41.2 percent year-on-year. Net loss was recorded at INR 7 million. For the first half of fiscal year 2026-27, gross bookings reached INR 42,661 million, representing an 11 percent year-on-year increase. Revenue for the half year was INR 4,015 million, with adjusted EBITDA at INR 301 million. Net loss for the half year was INR 4 million. The company announced that an earnings conference call will be held on November 13, 2026, at 11:30 AM Indian Standard Time to discuss these results.

attchmntText: Please find the enclosed herewith Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Yatra Online Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange and BSE. The report, issued by ICRA Limited on November 12, 2026, confirms no deviation in the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer. The company raised net proceeds of INR 570.097 Crore. As of the quarter end, INR 500.631 Crore was utilized. Unutilized funds totaling INR 69.466 Crore were deployed in fixed deposits with Yes Bank, Unity Small Finance Bank, and IDFC Bank. The implementation of strategic investments and organic growth initiatives remains on schedule. The report is available on the company website at www.yatra.com.

attchmntText: Yatra Online Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Yatra Online Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 1,664.14 million INR. Profit for the quarter was 94.69 million INR. Earnings per share stood at 0.60. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 3,234.54 million INR. Profit for the period was 157.51 million INR. Earnings per share were 1.00. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 11,999.17 million INR. Cash and cash equivalents were 552.36 million INR. The statutory auditors conducted a limited review and reported no material misstatements. The company noted queries from the National Stock Exchange and SEBI regarding deposits of 3,391.44 million INR from IPO proceeds. Management responded to these queries.
